reason: I'd download it and use the free 3 fragments a day, but I won't start a 7-day trial that turns into a subscription — I've been caught by that before with ELSA. Until I see it actually hears my mic properly for a couple of weeks, I'm not paying.
objection: It will crash or mishear my microphone like the last app, and the 'free week' will quietly charge me when I forget to cancel.
would_change_my_mind: If after two weeks on the free plan it worked without glitches and the scores matched what a real IELTS tutor told me, I'd pay for one month — not the year.
